description: This file defines a utility class for limiting the size of JPEG images by adjusting quality and scaling. It provides a method to compress images to a specified maximum byte size, iteratively decreasing quality and scale as needed.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterResult
classes.description: Data class holding the result of JPEG size limiting, including the encoded byte array, dimensions, and quality.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiter
classes.description: Utility object providing functionality to compress JPEG images to a size limit by adjusting quality and scale.

methods.name: compressToLimit
methods.description: Compresses a JPEG image to fit within a specified maximum byte size by adjusting quality and scaling iteratively.
